title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Division of Property 1864 views Q. We are two brothers and one sister, mother deceased. My late father fixed Rs.300,000- in a bank and was taking interest on it, during his life. In the bank records he nominated my name and my sister's name as his successors. Now after his death bank has remitted Rs.300,000- (as we refused to take interest) by a cheque in my and sister's name. Will this amount be distributed among 3 of us or only 2 successors nominated by my father? How this amount will be distributed? 1586 views Q. I worked as a govt. Servant on a big post & earned money equal to my husband, we both acquired some property out of our earnings; my husband did not inherit anything from his father & fore fathers. I have only 1 daughter, my husband expired suddenly due to heart failure. Soon after his death his brother and four sisters who are well settled abroad have sent a legal notice to me regarding their share. I want to know which share they are asking. 1826 views Q. Inheritance 1669 views Q. If I have inherited some land/money from my father and I have 6 sisters and mother alive how it would be distributed since I am only son 1605 views Q. A father makes a will (wasiyat nama) for his own children during his life time for his immovable property 9834 views Q. Request to answer the below question enlighten with hadith & Quran We have received a Tarka for my late mother . We have received this after the expiry of my mother and father. My Father?s family consist of 2 sons and six sisters.All are married and well settled. We have received an amount 300,000 Rupees as for my mother. My question is wheather all my sisters(I mean Brothers & Sisters) are eligible for this tarka of my mother or it?s only for sons. If yes ,to the daughters and sons , I would like to shares in percentage. 2082 views Q. We are two brothers and six sisters, i have my father money, how can we much divide this money? 3937 views Q. Inheritance Distribution: Dividing Land and House Among Heirs 1905 views Q. My Grandfather had 2 sons and 2 daughters. He was a farmer and had many acres of agricultural land. He died leaving no official will 38 years ago. For many years whilst my mother was alive, she had tried unsuccessfully to wind up the estate. This was not done since she and her brothers never agreed on a value - she always felt that she was getting short changed. To add to this problem - She was in South Africa and her brothers in India... ? 1824 views Q. I have a few questions regarding my cousin's father who has just passed away recently.He had business dealing with others, and some of those deals are not complete. Some people still owe him money, and some of those people claim he owes them money. Others have come after he passed away and claimed he owed them money. I would like to know the ins and outs of debt.What can/should be done about this? 1410 views Q. How can a property be divided between 2 sons and one daughter? 10404 views Q. My father purchased a house in my mother's name 25 years ago where we are living in.We are 7 brothers(including me) & 2 sisters who are already married.Being an eldest brother I spent my own earnings on my brothers & sisters studies & even I contributed in the construction(extension) of the same house.My immediate younger brothers & me spent money on our 2 sisters' marriages(hefty sum).My qustions are A).will my sisters get share in the house property? B).How will be the property distribution? My parents are alive alhamdulillah. 1752 views Q. How Inheritance will be distributed? 1671 views Q. Division of money of uncle 1491 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 7030 Country: India Title: I have a question about inheretance. My father died many years back but we got some property from his share of family land 4 years back. The said property has to be distributed amongst wife( my mother ) and 2 sons ( me and my younger brother ): The chain is given below : 1. MY MOTHER 2. My younger brother who is married but with no children. 3. Myself , married with wife and 3 daughters. Can you please advice the share of each in the light of the Quran and Hadith. Jazaak allah o khair. Asif =-- 3. My self. Question: Assalam o alaikum , Mufti sahab, I have a question about inheretance. My father died many years back but we got some property from his share of family land 4 years back. The said property has to be distributed amongst wife( my mother ) and 2 sons ( me and my younger brother ): The chain is given below : 1. MY MOTHER 2. My younger brother who is married but with no children. 3. Myself , married with wife and 3 daughters. Can you please advice the share of each in the light of the Quran and Hadith. Jazaak allah o khair. Asif =-- 3. My self. Answer ID: 7030 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1016/896=L/1429) If your grandparents were not alive at the time of your father?s death, also you do not have any sister, then after paying all due rights proceeding inheritance, the property left by your father shall be divided in this way; the eighth part of the property shall go to your mother while the rest shall be distributed among you two brothers equally. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
